desc: Characterize the operation via the parse forest: reachable strings are exactly plane embeddings of the initial unordered rooted forest, counted by bottom-up DP over unordered tree types.

Implement the complete Python program: parse S with a stack into a rooted forest, precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N modulo 998244353, canonicalize unordered tree types bottom-up using sorted child-type tuples, compute each new type's value as fact[d] * ∏ pow(val[child], count) * invfact[count], compute the top-level forest answer with the same formula, read stdin/write stdout, and verify the samples.
